id: title:Gilbert09:add four aws compute optimizer tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion support for AWS Compute Optimizer RDS and idle-resource recommendations, including projected metrics, to PostHog's warehouse connector.
review.reason: The change adds executable implementation and configuration for three new AWS Compute Optimizer recommendation types: RDS database recommendations, idle resource recommendations, and projected metrics. P1.F4.H2 and P1.F4.H3 introduce the necessary endpoint definitions and optional configuration fields, while P1.F5.H1 updates metadata. P1.F1.H1 checks and documentation support these
review.uncertainty: While the implementation is present, the actual benefit depends on whether PostHog customers utilize these specific AWS Compute Optimizer recommendation types and whether the ingestion successfully retrieves and displays this data. No tests or runtime behavior are supplied.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and configuration changes. No executable implementation, tests, or runtime behavior is supplied. No tier can be assigned.
